# BER Services - Enterprise Digital Engineering & Technology Solutions

> BER Services Private Limited is a full-service technology company engineering bespoke websites, scalable eCommerce architectures, custom software, cross-platform mobile applications, and AI workflow automations.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Website Designing & Development](https://thebermedia.com/services-we-provide/website-designing-development): Enterprise web architectures, custom responsive UI/UX, and sub-second Core Web Vitals optimization.
- [eCommerce Website Development](https://thebermedia.com/services-we-provide/ecommerce-website-development): High-converting digital storefronts, Shopify Plus, WooCommerce, and secure multi-currency payment gateways.
- [Mobile App Development](https://thebermedia.com/services-we-provide/mobile-app-development): Native iOS & Android applications and cross-platform React Native / Flutter engineering.
- [Custom Software Development](https://thebermedia.com/services-we-provide/custom-software-development): Bespoke SaaS platforms, internal enterprise tools, and cloud infrastructure.
- [Digital Marketing & SEO](https://thebermedia.com/services-we-provide/digital-marketing): Data-driven search engine optimization, technical audits, and performance marketing.
- [AI Automation Services](https://thebermedia.com/services-we-provide/ai-automation): Conversational AI chatbots, enterprise RAG systems, and automated workflow orchestrations.
